text:
Mira Patel: Heads up — Clarus Edge just dropped a final asset pack for our joint marketplace listing. I uploaded clarus_edge_assets_v4.zip to the shared drive. Need quick brand + legal sanity checks before we send to Azure Marketplace. Specifically: logo clearspace, color variants, partner quote usage, and hero image alt text. Goal: publish by EOD Thu. :wave:

Dan Cho: Got the upload. Quick Q — which logo do they want in the thumbnail? They included a horizontal and a stacked mark. Thumbnail space is tight (300x180). My vote = stacked mark centered.

Jess Alvarez: Stacked mark is better for small sizes. Also flag: their PNG has a 6px shadow we need removed for marketplace. Can we get a clean SVG? @Mira Patel can you ask them to send SVG without effects?

Mira Patel: @Jess noted. I already asked Clarus for SVGs without effects and transparent PNGs. They said new files will be in the drive in ~45m.

Priya Rao: Quick legal note — partner quote in solution_brief_v3.pdf references specific customer names without written consent. We need either (a) written sign-off from Clarus referencing permission, or (b) redact names and replace with anonymized language. Also confirm trademark usage matches their brand guidelines.

Sam (Design): For hero_3.png — contrast looks low when overlaid with our CTA. Suggest moving the hero crop up 60px and darkening overlay to 28% black. Mockup CSS I used: ```background-image: url(hero_3.png); background-position: center -60px; background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.28); background-blend-mode: multiply;``` Will attach a quick mock in the drive (clarus_edge_mock_v1.png).

BrandBot: Asset check summary: logos: missing SVG (requested). color palette: OK (primary #0A5FFF matches partner guide). fonts: Clarus uses Inter; we must embed only system fallbacks in marketplace tile. alt text: missing on hero_3.png metadata.

Dan Cho: Also pinging eng-marketing for thumbnail size check. @Sam (Design) can you export the thumbnail at @2x for retina (@600x360)?

Sam (Design): On it — will upload clarus_thumb_600x360.png in 20m.

Priya Rao: Also: clarify the partner quote attribution line. If Clarus legal can confirm consent by EOD Thu we can keep it. Otherwise we need a generic case blurb.

Mira Patel: Noted. I'll consolidate and reply to Clarus thread with a checklist: 1) SVG logo without effects, 2) written permission for customer quote or alternate copy, 3) clean transparent PNGs, 4) hero image alt text and higher-contrast variant, 5) final short partner blurb for marketplace metadata.

Jess Alvarez: One more micro-ask — please include a 1:1 lockup of our logos for co-brand hero (SVG). Marketplace sometimes surfaces that.

Mira Patel: Adding that to the checklist. Thanks everyone — will update here when Clarus uploads new files. If legal/brand sign-off lands before noon we can aim for the EOD publish. :thumbsup:
